ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels and 35% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally localized high-intensity white contiguous block with low-intensity black margins along the trailing edge and distal tip; high-frequency mottling present at pixel interfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary along the trailing edge with approximately 12-14 distinct peaks and variable-depth valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve fitting the outer boundary of the visible left lobe from the medial to distal regions.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of roughly 10 circular high-contrast pixel nodes at the distal tip (barnacle attachment points).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-intensity linear pixel tracks (rake marks) traversing the low-intensity pigmented region near the distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring and parasitic attachment (barnacles) visible on the distal portion of the fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive white linear streaks and spotting pattern on the dark-pigmented distal surface.
